coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Commons
record.summary: A roughly two-acre lawn and green space at 3rd Street and Mission Bay Boulevard in Mission Bay, part of the city's Mission Bay Parks system; the San Francisco Recreation and Park Department took over its management and maintenance from OCII/the Port on July 1, 2023. No source checked gives this lawn's own original construction or opening date.

notes.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project's 2028-2030 construction.

milestones.text: Park P16 -- per OCII's own Nov 2024 CAC map, at this record's own location (the east end of the Mission Bay Commons strip, between 3rd St and Terry Francois Blvd) -- described as "the newest segment of the Mission Bay Commons Park system" and "recently completed" as of this date, funded partly by a DTSC brownfields grant

sources.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (archived press release)

open_questions: The only dated event found is SF Rec & Park's July 1, 2023 assumption of management from OCII, which is a management transfer, not a construction-completion date -- not used as a completion milestone, per this repo's rule against attributing an area-wide/administrative event to an individual record's build status.

2026-09-22 pass: OCII's own Nov 2024 CAC map places labels P16 and P17 specifically at the east end of the Mission Bay Commons strip (between 3rd St and Terry Francois Blvd), matching this record's own mapped lawn -- resolving which OCII labels apply here, versus the P11/P12/P13/P15 labels used for the separate, still-interim area further west (mission_bay_commons_interim_west). The only dated source found (a Nov 2011 EPA press release) names just P16, not P17, and says the park was "recently completed" rather than giving a construction date or a dedication date -- so the milestone above is deliberately narrower than that OCII grouping might suggest.
